latest_release.body:
# NVM for Windows v2.0.1

Authenticode-signed community build from `cli/src/manifest.json` version `2.0.1`.
Architectures: amd64, arm64.
Program root: per-user LocalAppData (unsupported outside that root may log NVM4101).
Org Program Files / MSI / Intune: use NVM for Windows Certified Builds.

Assets per arch: Inno Setup installer (`*-setup.exe`) and prebuilt `sync.exe` (`*-sync.exe`) for public `-DownloadSync` builds.

More devices from OEM and silicon partners will be available in the coming months.
NVM for Windows is not the same thing as nvm! (expand for details) _The original [nvm](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm) is a completely separate project for Mac/Linux only._ This project uses an entirely different philosophy and is not just a clone of nvm.
